import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Complex Polynomial LinearMap FiniteDimensional Module Module.End
open scoped BigOperators

theorem double_neg_smul {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F] [Module F V]
  (a : F) (v : V) : (-a) • (-v) = a • v := by
  have h1 : (-a) • (-v) = - (a • (-v)) := by
    rw [← neg_smul]
    <;> simp [neg_neg]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> simp_all [neg_smul]
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have h2 : a • (-v) = - (a • v) := by
    rw [smul_neg]
    <;> simp [neg_neg]
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have h3 : (-a) • (-v) = - (- (a • v)) := by
    calc
      (-a) • (-v) = - (a • (-v)) := h1
      _ = - (- (a • v)) := by rw [h2]
  
  have h4 : - (- (a • v)) = a • v := by
    rw [neg_neg]
  
  have h5 : (-a) • (-v) = a • v := by
    calc
      (-a) • (-v) = - (- (a • v)) := h3
      _ = a • v := h4
  
  exact h5

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Complex Polynomial LinearMap FiniteDimensional Module Module.End
open scoped BigOperators

theorem double_neg_smul {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F] [Module F V]
  (a : F) (v : V) : (-a) • (-v) = a • v := by
  have h_neg_v : (-v : V) = (-1 : F) • v := by
    have h₁ : (-v : V) = - (1 • v) := by
      simp [one_smul]
    have h₂ : - (1 • v) = (-1 : F) • v := by
      simp [neg_smul]
      <;>
      simp_all [neg_neg]
      <;>
      abel
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    <;>
    simp_all [neg_neg]
    <;>
    abel
  
  have h_subst : (-a) • (-v) = (-a) • ((-1 : F) • v) := by
    rw [h_neg_v]
    <;>
    simp_all
  
  have h_smul_smul : (-a) • ((-1 : F) • v) = ((-a) * (-1 : F)) • v := by
    rw [smul_smul]
    <;>
    simp_all [mul_neg]
    <;>
    abel
  
  have h_mul_neg : ((-a) * (-1 : F)) = a := by
    calc
      ((-a) * (-1 : F)) = (-a) * (-1 : F) := rfl
      _ = a := by
        
        have h₁ : (-a : F) * (-1 : F) = a := by
          
          ring_nf
          <;> simp [mul_neg, mul_one]
          <;> abel
        
        simpa using h₁
  
  have h_final : ((-a) * (-1 : F)) • v = a • v := by
    rw [h_mul_neg]
    <;>
    simp_all
  
  have h_main : (-a) • (-v) = a • v := by
    calc
      (-a) • (-v) = (-a) • ((-1 : F) • v) := by rw [h_subst]
      _ = ((-a) * (-1 : F)) • v := by rw [h_smul_smul]
      _ = a • v := by rw [h_final]
  
  exact h_main
